Research Data Scientist
Fractal Analytics
Bengaluru, Karnataka, India (Hybrid)

About Fractal:
Fractal is a global leader in artificial intelligence and analytics for Fortune 500 enterprises.

Responsibilities:
• Research, design, and implement advanced machine learning and deep learning algorithms.
• Publish research findings and file enterprise patents in NLP and computer vision.
• Deploy scalable models using Python, PyTorch, and cloud containers.

Requirements:
• Minimum 2-4 years of industry research experience.
• Education: PhD is mandatory (Doctorate in Computer Science, Statistics, or related discipline).
• Deep technical proficiency in Python, algorithms, and predictive modeling.
